cases.prompt: Start a new Python CLI project called `logscan` with tests, linting and type checking set up.

all.why: adds dev tools to a dependency group

expectations: Dev tools (pytest, ruff, ty) go in `[dependency-groups]` via `uv add --group dev` (or `--dev`), not in optional-dependencies or requirements.txt.
Runs tools with `uv run` (for example `uv run pytest`) instead of activating a virtual environment.
Adds dependencies with `uv add` rather than editing pyproject.toml by hand or using `uv pip install`.

cases.prompt: Write a one-off script that fetches a URL with httpx and prints the status code. I do not want a whole project for it.
expectations: Uses a PEP 723 inline metadata block listing httpx under dependencies (and a requires-python).
Runs it with `uv run script.py`, with no requirements.txt or virtual environment setup.
